nodes.name: Apify — Scrape Google Maps (FREE)
nodes.notes:
APIFY FREE TIER — $5 credits/month, NO credit card required.

SETUP:
1. Go to https://apify.com → Sign Up (free, no card)
2. Settings → Integrations → copy your API Token
3. In this node: replace YOUR_APIFY_API_TOKEN in the token query param

The searchStringsArray is auto-built from your form input (keyword + location).
This node runs synchronously — waits for results before continuing.
